ande: heads-up: seeing a latency spike on prod-usw2 p95 +120ms compared to baseline

ryan: agree hold at 25% while we validate. running quick checks: `rdwctl logs --since 1m --service api | grep ERROR`
deploy-bot: Manual hold applied by @ryan. Rollout paused at 25%.

ryan: ok after the tweak i'll unhold and resume ramp
ryan: resuming rollout now → ramp to 60%

deploy-bot: Deployment complete · release-2026-03-15 (commit 4a1b2c3) promoted to 100% in prod. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2026-03-15-release-notes
deploy-bot: If you need to revert: `rdw rollback 4a1b2c3` or roll back to tag `release-2026-03-14`
sasha: :tada: noted and adding to the release tracker
prod-oncall: monitors are green across regions, closing change window
ryan: thanks all, will follow up with perf postmortem in #eng-releases tomorrow
